privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body:
## Who processes your data
The controller is Anna Bērziņa ({email}).

## What is collected
The name, email address, subject and message entered in the contact form. Nothing else is collected.

## Why
Solely to reply to your message (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a) — consent).

## How long
Messages are kept for no longer than 12 months after the last contact.

## Third parties
If the form is connected to a form-handling service, data is passed to that processor only to deliver the message.

## Cookies and analytics
This site uses no cookies or analytics. Only your language preference is stored in your browser (localStorage).

## Your rights
You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data by writing to {email}. You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Data State Inspectorate of Latvia.
